Dave Matthews Band
September 3, 2023
The Gorge Amphitheater
George, WA

Taper: Noam Yemini
Location: Back of Pit, Stage Left Stack
Source: MXL604 (cardioid capsule) -> Tascam DR-40
Conversion: This is the original 48k, 24 bit.  Another mp3 version also exists.

Notes: 

There is some wind noise in a few areas.  
I removed as much of it as I could and the result is around 4 areas, mostly in between songs.
